description: This Java class defines a Fragment named PhotoFragment used in an Android application to display and handle photos, including loading images from URLs, handling click events to broadcast zoom actions, and managing its state across lifecycle events.

classes.name: PhotoFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment class for displaying a photo, loading it from a URL, handling click events, and managing its state.

methods.name: loadPhoto
methods.description: Converts the stored URL string to a URL object and attempts to download and display the image in the PhotoView.

methods.name: getURLString
methods.description: Returns the current URL string of the photo being displayed.

methods.name: setPhoto
methods.description: Sets the URL string for the photo to be displayed.
